The '''PW-15 XT Plasma Core Sniper Rifle''' was a model of [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The PW-15 XT Plasma Core Sniper Rifle was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Mid Rim Explorer Pack, which was released to the Cartel Market on [[June 9]], [[2015]].
